environment._comment_time_limit: Seconds. Budget = commitment + swap delay + reversal + traverse to the OTHER target. The worst informative cell (delta = 0.5%) needs ~14 + 1 + 35 + 70 = 120 s; the floor cells need far more and CENSOR BY CONSTRUCTION, which is the measurement, not a failure -- the censoring rate is a reported quantity per cell. Matched to the DDM arm's limit so the arms are censored on the same clock.
environment._comment_ticks_per_second: ARENA clock, dt = 1.0 s. MUST equal the agent's own ticks_per_second below: under sensory_stream.mode 'shared' that equality is a FATAL precondition checked in models/percept_stream.py (white_rate is a RATE, so an unequal pair leaves the stream's dt ambiguous and the two model families would not receive the same realisation).

sensory_stream._comment: IDENTICAL to the DDM arm's block -- this is the object of the whole design. c = sqrt(2)*white_rate = 0.100 is the DDM's noise scale; the ring attractor has no 'c', but it consumes the SAME per-tick percept q_hat_i = q_i + beta_i + eps_i(t). The stream keys every draw by (trial_seed, kind, target_id, tick) only, so the realisation is independent of how many internal sub-steps a model takes: the DDM's n_sub = 16 and the RA's 500 field steps per tick both see one draw per arena tick. seed null resolves per trial from the arena random_seed; frozen_sd = 0 because a frozen bias imposes an accuracy ceiling Phi(A/s_beta) that flattens every curve.

arena_0._comment_side: SquareArena reads 'side' (spanning [-side/2, side/2]) and SILENTLY IGNORES 'radius'. The historical mean-field templates set 'radius': 1 and were therefore running the DEFAULT side, not a matched arena. Set explicitly here and matched to the DDM arm.

environment._comment_post_bifurcation_swap: 'attributes' IS MANDATORY HERE. arena._normalize_post_bif_swap_config defaults it to ('position',) when the key is absent, and a POSITION swap is a no-op for this experiment: both models sign their decision variable by target_ids order, so exchanging coordinates leaves q0 - q1 untouched and produces no drift reversal. Exchanging STRENGTH flips the drift sign while preserving |dQ|. The historical mean-field flexibility configs omitted this key and were therefore running a silent no-op swap. The color exchange is the on-screen sanity indicator. delay_ticks = 1 at ticks_per_second = 1 is a 1.0 s physical delay, matching the model-internal quality_swap.delay it replaces.

static_0._comment: R = 0.5 m at -30 deg; 60 deg separation from static_1. The BETTER target before the swap by construction; strengths are overwritten per condition with the mean-preserving pair Qbar*(1 +/- delta/2).

movable_0._comment_linear_velocity: m/s. Travel budget T_b = R/v = 0.5/0.01 = 50 s. This value is what makes the design work: the reversal boundary in delta scales as 1/sqrt(T_b) while the tick-resolution ceiling does not move at all, so dropping v from 0.05 to 0.01 opens a band that is simultaneously reversal-feasible and time-resolved. Matched to the DDM arm.
movable_0._comment_angular_velocity: deg/s. Minimum turn radius is v/omega = 0.01/(120*pi/180) = 0.0048 m, comfortably inside the 0.05 m termination radius, so the agent can turn around after a reversal instead of orbiting.

mean_field_model._comment_integration: 500 field steps (integration_time / integration_dt) per ONE arena tick, with the tick's percept held constant across all of them (models/mean_field_systems.py). This is a QUASI-STATIC field: the bump is integrated to relaxation within each tick. Intended, but note it is exactly the assumption most at risk in the ra_uc arm, where critical slowing down makes the relaxation time diverge -- which is why bump amplitude is logged rather than assumed.
mean_field_model._comment_g_adapt: ZERO BY CHOICE, not by default: with no spike-frequency adaptation the ring attractor has no internal mechanism to escape its own basin, so a reversal must be driven by the INPUT alone. That is what makes the rigidity claim for u = 8 clean. A g_adapt > 0 arm is the obvious follow-up if u = 8 proves absolutely rigid.
mean_field_model._comment_v: Kernel amplitude, FIXED. u_c = 6.156868 is the critical coupling for THIS v (from the matched (v, u*) table used by the RA/DDM frontier sweep); changing v invalidates the ra_uc arm.
mean_field_model._comment_u: Overridden per arm: ra_uc -> 6.156868 (the critical point ITSELF, not a supercritical offset), ra_u8 -> 8.
mean_field_model._comment_sigma: Internal NEURAL noise. Deliberately NOT shared with the DDM -- it has no DDM counterpart. Only the SENSORY channel is shared, via sensory_stream above.
mean_field_model._comment_sigma_s: MUST be 0 under sensory_stream.mode 'shared' (fatal check in models/percept_stream.py): the model-owned sensory noise has moved upstream into the shared stream, and leaving the historical 1.0 here would add a second, UNSHARED noise source on top and silently unpair the arms.
mean_field_model._comment_bifurcation: This detector is what TRIGGERS the arena's post_bifurcation_swap, so its settings are part of the world change, not just instrumentation. alignment_consecutive_ticks is set to 1 (the code default is 5) to match the DDM arm: at ticks_per_second = 1 the default would insert 5 s of extra slack between commitment and swap in this arm only, and the swap timing has to be identical across arms.

results._comment_snapshots_per_second: Equal to the tick rate, i.e. per-tick rows. The code default of 1/s would be fine here only because the tick rate is also 1; kept explicit so a later tick-rate change does not silently under-sample the post-swap reversal, which is the whole object of this scenario.
